TASSO 3.0 - FEATURE INDEX
=================================

1. CLEANUP
   - 5 levels: Classic (~1 min), Normal, Medium (recommended), Deep, Extreme
     (each level also does everything the levels before it do)
   - Preview: before starting, it tells you how many junk files it found
   - Your temporary files and Windows temporary files
   - Recycle Bin
   - Thumbnail cache
   - Browser cache: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox (passwords and cookies stay)
   - App cache: Discord, Steam, Teams, Epic Games
   - Graphics card cache (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, DirectX)
   - Windows Update cache
   - Useless system files: error reports, dumps, old logs (no pop-up windows)
   - Windows component cleanup (DISM)
   - DNS cache
   - Scheduled cleanup (Home): day, time, level (Deep or Extreme too), every 1 or 2 weeks
   - PC score from 1 to 100: component speed, Windows lightness, overall score and
     rank (from "Slow PC" to "top"), also before and after the cleanup
   - Automatic PC shutdown when the cleanup is finished

2. SPEED
   - Modes: Normal, Gaming, Competitive FPS, Movie, Quiet
     (with a warning if the PC isn't suited: laptop, little RAM)
   - Turbo: closes useless background programs while you play
   - Startup apps: an on/off switch for each one
   - Startup guard: lets you know if a new program adds itself
   - Defragmentation (hard drives) and TRIM (SSDs)

3. PROGRAMS AND UPDATES
   - Complete uninstall, with a search for leftover folders
   - Removal of preinstalled apps (Candy Crush, TikTok, Solitaire, etc.)
   - Program updates (winget): a list of programs with a new version, one by one or all
   - Drivers for the whole PC: AMD/NVIDIA/Intel graphics card, audio, mouse, keyboard,
     network, Bluetooth, webcam; Windows Update and official websites; automatic
     driver downloads
   - Real program icons
   - Windows updates
   - Browser extension check
   - A check of every program (broken Windows apps, programs with no folder)

4. FILES
   - Duplicate files (the first one stays; the copies go to the Recycle Bin only if you
     confirm)
   - Largest files (over 100 MB, 300 MB or 1 GB), in other folders and external drives too
   - Empty folders
   - Broken shortcuts on the Desktop and in the Start menu
   - Tidy up the Downloads folder by file type
   - Shred private files, even several files at once
   - Wipe free space (before selling the PC)
   - Recover deleted files (Recycle Bin + free Microsoft tool)

5. REPAIR AND SECURITY
   - Automatic backup (restore point) before the big cleanups
   - Fix problems: audio, internet, Windows Update, printer, Store, search
   - Game problems (13): stuttering, low FPS, high ping, game won't start, launchers,
     black screen, controller and headset, Xbox and Game Pass, anti-cheat, Discord,
     mouse aim, game that minimizes by itself, slow downloads
   - Windows repair (DISM + SFC)
   - Disk error check
   - Device check
   - Disk health, wear and temperature
   - Antivirus scan with Microsoft Defender
   - Privacy: stop Windows ads and tracking (with a button to restore)

5a. OFFICE (Office mode)
   - The 100 most common work PC problems, each with a button, sorted into groups.
     In Fix problems there's a single search for all of them (Office, Gaming and Windows):
   Printing & scanners:
     - The printer says "offline"
     - It always prints on the wrong printer
     - "Print to PDF" is missing
     - I can't find the printer (or other PCs) on the network
     - The USB printer doesn't show up
     - The scanner doesn't work
   Word, Excel, Office & Adobe:
     - Office freezes or shows errors
     - Update Office
     - I lost a document I hadn't saved
     - Word or Excel closes as soon as you open it
     - Office keeps asking you to sign in or says "unlicensed"
     - The Teams button is missing in Outlook
     - Word or Excel is slow, flickers or stays blank
     - Word or Excel won't save to OneDrive or SharePoint
     - A downloaded file opens in "Protected View"
     - The file is "locked by another user"
     - Wrong dates, decimals or CSV files in Excel
     - Adobe Acrobat Reader won't open PDFs or freezes
   Outlook & email:
     - Outlook won't open
     - Outlook search doesn't find my emails
     - Emails don't arrive or don't send
     - Outlook is slow: the mailbox is too big
     - Outlook keeps asking for the password
     - Outlook attachments won't open
     - Outlook reminders are going crazy
     - Outlook doesn't update or shows empty folders
     - Outlook has changed: I want the old one back
     - Links in emails won't open
     - "No email program" when I send a file by email
   Teams & meetings:
     - Teams is slow, blank or won't open
     - People can't hear me in meetings
     - The webcam doesn't work
     - Bluetooth headphones won't connect
     - I can't hear the others in meetings
     - Teams and Outlook notifications don't arrive
     - The webcam is "in use by another program"
     - The volume goes down by itself during calls
   Files, folders & zip:
     - Files open with the wrong program
     - .zip files won't open or give an error
     - "The file name is too long"
     - I can't delete or rename a file ("it's open in another program")
     - I deleted a file by mistake
     - A folder or file has disappeared (maybe it's hidden)
     - Desktop icons that don't open anything anymore
     - Folders open slowly or with the wrong view
     - File Explorer opens on "Home" instead of "This PC"
     - The C: drive is full
     - Windows 11: the right-click menu is short
   Network, Wi-Fi & VPN:
     - The Wi-Fi keeps dropping
     - The Wi-Fi won't connect
     - The VPN won't connect
     - With the VPN on, office websites won't open
     - Network drives have a red X
     - The network folder keeps asking for a password
     - The internet works but websites won't open
     - The network cable is plugged in but doesn't work
     - Updates and OneDrive stuck: "metered connection"
     - Internet is slow only on this PC
     - Remote Desktop: black screen, slow, or won't connect
     - A work website is blocked for no reason
     - The laptop can't get online on a different network
   Screens & USB:
     - The second screen is black
     - The projector or TV shows nothing
     - The screen is rotated
     - Text is blurry or too small
     - USB stick, USB drive or dock not working
     - Mouse, USB sticks or other USB devices disconnect by themselves
     - The screen turns off or locks too soon
     - The brightness changes by itself
     - Win + Shift + S (screenshot) doesn't work
   Mouse, keyboard & laptop:
     - The keyboard types the wrong symbols
     - Copy and paste doesn't work
     - I want to find things I copied earlier (Win + V)
     - The mouse is too slow, too fast, or double-click doesn't work
     - The laptop's touchpad doesn't work
     - The number pad is off when I turn on the PC
     - The keyboard beeps, types slowly, or keys stay pressed
     - The Windows key doesn't work
     - The laptop battery doesn't last long
   Windows slow or frozen:
     - File Explorer freezes or is slow
     - Taskbar frozen or icons missing
     - The taskbar hides by itself
     - The desktop icons have disappeared
     - A program isn't responding
     - The PC is slow right now
     - Strange text or missing characters
     - I can't see previews of photos and documents
     - I can't see .pdf .docx at the end of file names
     - The PC takes a long time to start
     - Turning off the PC doesn't make problems go away
     - The PC won't go to sleep or wakes up by itself
   Time, OneDrive, accounts & security:
     - The time is wrong (and websites show errors)
     - OneDrive isn't syncing
     - Free up space with OneDrive
     - OneDrive has duplicate files with the PC's name
     - Check for suspicious programs
     - The "Activate Windows" message shows up
     - I signed in with a "temporary profile" (empty desktop)
     - My Windows password is about to expire
     - The PC asks for the BitLocker recovery key

5b. GAMES (Gaming mode)
   - Steam, Epic and Riot library with covers
   - Game profile (a switch that stays on after a restart) and per-game power
   - Tune with Tasso, Gaming commands explained, Optimize before playing
   - Game server ping, in-game overlay, autoclicker

6. HARDWARE
   - Components: processor, graphics card, motherboard, BIOS, RAM, disks, system
   - Real-time processor and RAM usage
   - NVIDIA graphics card: temperature, usage, fan, memory
   - BIOS: version and the maker's official page (with a warning about the risks)
   - Opens the NVIDIA / AMD control panel

7. SETTINGS
   - Tasso mode: Gaming or Office (button at the top left; it only changes how Tasso
     looks)
   - Gaming themes: Tasso, Aurora, Lava, Neon, Carbon, Beast, Ice, Sand
   - Office themes: Office, Paper, Sage, Lavender, Night, Slate, Ice, Sand
   - Tasso on / off
   - Undo: the list of everything Tasso has changed, a button for each thing and
     one for everything. Turning off or restarting the PC doesn't put anything back
     by itself
   - Start with Windows
   - Smart alerts (never in Gaming or FPS mode)

WHAT'S NEW IN 2.6
   - Detect problems (at the top of the menu with Fix problems, and as a button in Home):
     checks for 58 problems in about a minute without changing anything and shows only
     the ones it found, with Fix
   - Internet: "Your connection" with tips (e.g. connect to 5 GHz) instead of
     data usage
   - Two modes: Gaming (everything, including games, FPS and ping) and Office (simpler and
     calmer, with a cuter badger). You choose it the first time you open Tasso and can
     switch whenever you want
   - The 100 most common office problems in Fix problems (also Word, Excel, Adobe,
     zip files, mouse and keyboard, accounts and BitLocker)
   - Fix problems split into sections (Office, Gaming, Windows) with a single search
   - 3 new game problems: mouse aim, game that minimizes by itself, slow downloads
   - PC score from 1 to 100 for everything, with overall score and rank
   - Games: your library at the top. Performance+ reorganized: easy, safe things first
   - 6 new themes for the office: Office, Paper, Sage, Lavender, Night, Slate
     (8 in all, with Ice and Sand)

WHAT'S NEW IN 2.5
   - Game profile with a switch: it stays on after a restart until you turn it off
   - Per-game power: High power or Maximum power, set automatically when you open the game
   - Game server ping with the best server for you
   - 10 gamer problems with one button each, drivers for the whole PC
   - 5 cleanup levels, scheduled cleanup every 1 or 2 weeks, PC score
   - Program updates, real icons, smarter Open any file
   - Undo, vault with a 4 to 12-digit PIN or no PIN
   - Tune with Tasso: recommended graphics settings for each game, based on the type of
     game and your PC (Automatic, Competitive, Balanced, Quality), with a dedicated PC
     mode and "Cancel"
   - Gaming commands: background recording, game priority, low-latency network,
     GPU scheduling, windowed game optimizations, clear standby memory,
     clear shader cache, restart graphics driver
   - Vault with a 4 to 12-digit PIN or no PIN (AES-256, only on this PC),
     password generator, stolen password check
   - Cleanup: driver leftovers, launcher cache, old graphics drivers, security,
     stability (crashes and hardware errors), activity traces
   - Discord: richer report with green checkmarks, every 3/6/12/24 hours, on request
     with !stato
   - Startup apps match Task Manager, including Store apps

WHAT'S NEW IN 2.4
   - Open any file: choose a file and Tasso tells you what it is and which program to
     open it with
   - One-click update: in Settings (with an alert in Home when a new version comes out),
     Tasso downloads itself and reopens by itself
   - "Check for updates" button and the version always in view, with a direct link to
     the Discord server
   - Fix problems: printer, Microsoft Store and apps, search and Start menu
   - Large files (over 300 MB): "Open folder" button to see them on your computer
   - Games: your library is the first thing you see
   - Speed: a table explains what really changes between the modes (and why the fans
     don't change right away)
   - Programs: clearer explanations and a warning not to remove games, Discord, Steam
     and Epic
   - Fixed a slight flicker in the program window

WHAT'S NEW IN 2.2
   - Games: Optimize before playing (closes heavy programs and reopens them when you're
     done playing)
   - See-through in-game overlay: CPU, graphics card (usage and temperature), RAM, time
     (Ctrl + Shift + F12 to show or hide it)
   - Autoclicker: how often, how many clicks, which button, fixed spot, small movements,
     hotkey of your choice
   - Game library with covers: Steam, Epic Games and Riot in one place
   - AMD Radeon graphics card temperature and usage (before, NVIDIA only)
   - PC status on Discord: a summary in your private channel (read-only)
   - Safer cleanup: temporary files in use stay, and it never follows shortcuts
   - The Stop button also interrupts the current step right away

WHAT'S NEW IN 2.1
   - PC health: a score from 0 to 100 with tips and a button to fix things
   - Internet: speed test (download, upload, ping), your connection with tips (e.g.
     connect to 5 GHz), saved Wi-Fi with passwords
   - Disk map: the biggest folders, largest first
   - Automatic game mode: Gaming when you open a game, then back to how it was
   - No Windows pop-up windows during cleanups

WHAT TASSO DOESN'T DO, ON PURPOSE
   - Registry cleaning: minimal benefits, risk of making Windows unstable
   - Constant "RAM freeing" and miracle "internet boosters": Windows already does this
     by itself (Tasso only offers the commands that really help, and tells you when
     they do)
   - Drivers from unknown websites or "update all drivers" programs: only Windows Update
     and official websites
   - Overclocking and automatic BIOS updates: too risky

COMING SOON
   - Digital signature (it needs a paid certificate)
   - Video and music player with subtitles, file converters
   - Recorder for the last 30 seconds of gameplay, stats on hours played
   - Ad blocking, webcam and microphone control
